# gaema

> gaema builds machine-learning systems, models and tools: interactive explanations of the math inside neural networks, reference drawings of AI accelerator architectures, and inference software for GPUs and NPUs that hardware makers can license.

Site content is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Search engines and AI systems may index these pages, answer from them and train on them.

## Sites

- [viz](https://viz.math.gaema.ai): Interactive visualizations of the math inside CNNs and LLMs, one page per mechanism, no build step.
- [arch](https://arch.hw.gaema.ai): Accelerator architectures from AMD, Intel, NVIDIA and Tenstorrent (die map, traced read and memory hierarchy), drawn to one structure so they compare.
- [engine](https://engine.gaema.ai): An inference engine for GPUs and NPUs, with its own compilers and runtimes, available for license. The licensing page is by invitation.
- [accelx](https://gaema.ai/accelx/): A GPU compute stack for Arm Mali GPUs (runtime, compiler and a Vulkan driver in development) that runs neural-network inference without Mesa, available for license.
- [serve](https://serve.gaema.ai): A voice assistant that talks and draws. By invitation.
- [github](https://github.com/gaema): Open-source projects and code.
